transcript: I've known Val for decades, and for him to come back and play that character, he's such a powerful actor that he instantly became that character again. I mean, that is, you're looking at Iceman. Did you cry when you guys shot that? I was crying. I was crying. I got emotional. He's such a brilliant actor. I love his work. That really was quite a moment.
metadata_caption:
Tom Cruise shares his heartfelt experience of reuniting with Val Kilmer in Top Gun: Maverick. Reflecting on their iconic bond from the original Top Gun, Cruise talks about the emotional impact of bringing their characters back together on screen and what it meant to work with Kilmer again after so many years. A nostalgic and powerful moment in cinematic history you don't want to miss!
